snippet.title: Zoidtrip - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slipcorp.paperplane

Also on the Apple AppStore: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/zoidtrip/id931526836?ls=1&mt=8

Is it a squid? Is it a kite? Is it a triangle? We don't know. It could be anything.

In Zoidtrip you have to take control of a triangle-shaped character with two floppy tails! Your goal is to go as far as possible to get a better score... and ultimately unlock new triangle-shaped heroes!

Features:

-   One tap gameplay: tap the screen to change direction.
-   Colorful graphics: a new color every time you play!
-   Compelling progression: reach a new score or collect enough points to unlock new characters.
-   Game Center: cool achievements and a leaderboard to challenge your friends!

Like us: https://www.facebook.com/microtripgame
Website: http://www.microtrip-game.com/zoidtrip
